item.title: Embedded Software (Firmware)
item.description:
Firmware Engineering

Writing scalable and clean firmware code using vendor APIs (HAL/LL), building real-time apps with FreeRTOS, and handling cellular/Wi-Fi wireless communication via MQTT protocol.
